common.noscript: JavaScript is disabled, so the converter cannot run. Enable JavaScript and reload this page to use it.

footer.fonts: Save converted text and files with a font or editor that can display combining characters.
footer.reportNote: Reports become public GitHub issues. A GitHub account is required, and anything you write can be read by anyone. Do not include personal information.

app.title: Gandhari Unicode Converter
app.lead: Converts characters of the “Gandhari Unicode” font, which uses the Unicode Private Use Area (PUA), into standard Unicode that uses combining characters.

text.inputHint: The text is converted exactly as entered. It is never trimmed or normalized.
text.outputHint: Read-only. Select the text to copy it manually if the copy button does not work.

converted.title: Converted
converted.body: {count} characters were converted. The result is shown below the input on narrow screens.

emptyKept.title: Nothing converted
emptyKept.body: The input is empty. The previous result is still shown.

cleared.title: Cleared
cleared.body: The input and the result were cleared.

copied.title: Copied
copied.body: The result was copied to the clipboard.

copyFailed.title: Copy failed
copyFailed.body: The browser did not allow copying. The result is selected; copy it manually.

copyUnavailable.title: Copy not available
copyUnavailable.body: This browser cannot copy automatically. The result is selected; copy it manually.

docx.title: DOCX file
docx.label: Choose a DOCX file
docx.hint: The file is processed in your browser and its contents are not uploaded. The page still loads two helper libraries from a CDN (cdnjs).
docx.invalidInline: Choose a file with the .docx extension.

none.title: No file selected
none.body: Choose a .docx file to enable conversion.

ready.title: Ready
ready.body: {name} is selected. Choose Convert and download.

invalid.title: Unsupported file
invalid.body: {name} is not a .docx file. Choose a file with the .docx extension.

success.title: Download started
success.body: {name} was sent to your browser’s download. Check that it was saved.

failure.title: Conversion failed
failure.body: {name} could not be converted. The file may be damaged or not a valid DOCX. Check the file and try again; the file is still selected.

missingLibrary.title: Conversion unavailable
missingLibrary.body: A required library did not load (it is fetched from a CDN). Check your connection, reload the page and try again.
